description:
Create three new product attributes and organize them into a 'Jewelry' attribute set. 

1. Create Attribute 'jewelry_material': Dropdown input, options: Gold, Silver, Bronze, Platinum. Filterable and Visible on Frontend.
2. Create Attribute 'gemstone_type': Dropdown input, options: Diamond, Ruby, Emerald, Sapphire, None. Filterable and Visible on Frontend.
3. Create Attribute 'chain_length_inches': Text Field input. Visible on Frontend.

4. Create a new Attribute Set named 'Jewelry' (based on Default). Inside it, create a new group 'Jewelry Specifications' and assign the three new attributes to this group.

If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!
